thread:
Olga: Quick recap from today's Horizon Health onboarding (45m). They27re happy with latency but raised three things blocking go-live: a PII/privacy API marker, team-level routing flags, and clearer per-account onboarding checklist visibility in Console. Putting raw asks here so we can prioritize. @Anya @Devon

Anya: Can you paste the exact asks so I can slot them into the PRD?

Olga: Copied from notes:
```
- API privacy marker: request-level header to mark sensitive traffic -> no persistence, skip KV cache writes, do not send to embeddings stores.
- Team routing flags: allow org/team toggle to route traffic to different model variants (prod -> high-SLA, non-prod -> cheaper)
- Console onboarding checklist: shareable, per-account status + owner, exportable for CSM reporting.
```

Marcos: This is tied to a renewal. Horizon said explicitly they can't go live without the PII marker. Renewal impact ~ $80k ARR.

Devon: Understood. @Sam can you give a short/long effort split? We need that for AE/CS.

Sam: Quick engineering take: header-based privacy opt-out is doable as a fast follow. Implementation plan sketch:
1) Accept X-Redwood-Privacy: pii (or similar) header
2) At runtime, bypass persistence paths (no request logs stored long-term, skip embeddings upload), avoid writing prefix/KV cache, mark as non-attributable for analytics
3) Provide audit-only capture that can be fetched via a legal/data request flow
Estimate: ~2 weeks core + 1 week QA/docs assuming infra pathing is straightforward. Trade-offs: token-level analytics will be partially degraded for marked requests.

Anya: Could we ship an API flag first and surface Console controls later? That helps CS move the renewal needle faster.

ProductOps: I can draft the rollout notes and a KB for CSMs. Recommend exposing header for early access, behind Enterprise gating for Console toggle. Will prepare one-pager and FAQs. :memo:

Olga: Marcos, do you want this marked as blocking in the renewal tracker?

Marcos: Yes, mark Horizon Health as renewal-blocking and attach these notes in Salesforce. Inform the AE.

Devon: Prioritization: P0 = PII header (renewal blocker). P1 = team-level routing flags. P2 = console onboarding checklist.

Sam: I'll kick off an RFC in eng-platform and include both the fast-path header approach and longer-term product controls (console toggle, per-account retention policies).

Anya: I'll open a GH issue, label customer-reported + renewal-blocker, and add acceptance criteria from the call.

ZenBot: Created issue redwood/infra#2345 from @Anya - https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/2345 :white_check_mark:

Olga: I'll upload the meeting recording + transcript to the SF account note and link the GH issue. Let's sync in 48h to finalize acceptance criteria. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
